items.title: At the Game: Ball State
items.summary: BOWLING GREEN, Ohio — Bowling Green will complete their in-conference homestand on Saturday as they square off against the Ball State Cardinals. Kickoff at Doyt Perry Stadium is set for Saturday at 12 p.m.
